name: Secureframe
summary: Secureframe supports SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, PCI DSS, GDPR, NIST and CMMC, with a Defense plan aimed at CMMC. Auditors get read-only access that an admin scopes by module and that ends when the audit closes. Plans are named Fundamentals, Complete and Defense, and no prices are published.

evidence.capability: framework templates such as soc 2 and iso 27001

facts.text: The home page names SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, PCI DSS, GDPR, NIST and CMMC among the frameworks it supports.

The pricing page lists Automated Evidence Collection, an Evidence Library and access to the Secureframe Audit Partner Network, but its comparison columns are unlabeled, so the plan for each row is unclear.
An admin adds an auditor to a specific audit, chooses which modules the auditor can see, and the auditor loses access after the audit is completed unless other audits are active.
The Defense plan is positioned for CMMC and lists an SSP, a POA&M and an SPRS score tracker.
The pricing page shows no dollar amounts and no free trial.

plans.name: Fundamentals
plans.notes: Includes one compliance framework, and more can be added

plans.name: Defense
plans.notes: Everything in Complete, plus CMMC tooling

hiddenCosts: Each plan includes one framework, and the page says additional quantities can be added.
The pricing table does not show which plan includes Automated Evidence Collection or the Audit Partner Network.
